name: ecsges-theme
description: Build SCSS (Dart Sass + autoprefixer) cho WordPress theme ECSGES → assets/css/main.css. Theme chạy không cần Node.

scripts.build:css: sass src/scss/main.scss assets/css/main.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && postcss assets/css/main.css --replace --use autoprefixer --no-map
